verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a chat and forge platform with a CLI, but the evidence never documents acting on many items at once. The CLI examples act on single items, such as creating one channel, protecting one repo ref or triggering one workflow. Agent orchestration and the benchmark's channel-invite task are different capabilities and do not count as bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
